book.title: Diꞌs wen chanꞌ Jesucrist jwanꞌ mkeꞌ Luk

content: Juan ndaꞌ xkiꞌs Dios

Lenꞌ linꞌ tsinꞌ chanꞌ Tiberio Cesar xaꞌ nyebeꞌ dib izyo chan' Rom, zya Poncio Pilato nak gobernador lo xyon Judea, Herodes nak gobernador lo xyon Galilea, Felip wes Herodes nak gobernador lo xyon Iturea nde re yez chanꞌ Traconite. Nde Lizaneas nak gobernador re yez chanꞌ Abilinia.
Zya Anas nde Caifas nak nglweyꞌ ro. Lenꞌ wiz ya mni Dios lo Juan xinꞌ Zacarias jwanꞌ nzo izyo nagan,
jwanꞌ nasa, nkete Juan rop lad ro yoꞌ Jordan ngwa tej Juan lo re men ke nakinꞌ seꞌ xaꞌ xgab xaꞌ nde laꞌ xaꞌ jwanꞌ narax ndli xaꞌ nde ryoꞌle xaꞌ lenꞌ nit sa dyonꞌ xken xaꞌ.
Jwanꞌ reꞌ ngok xa nchab lo ye's mke' profet Isaias:

content.text: Nchen mbez ti men lad izyo nagan.
Reta yeryo zye, reta yiꞌ nde reta kox ak lap,
nde reta ned narax nak, ak nali.
Nde reta men wiꞌ xa tola' Dios men."

content: Jwan' nasa nchab Juan lo re men toz tir jwan' nda lo Juan sa ryo'le: —¡Bin mzib nde goꞌ! ¿Cho ne lo go', lyaꞌ goꞌ lo yalnayiꞌ chanꞌ Dios jwanꞌ nde gaxla?

Ban goꞌ thi mod ke lo' liga mzyeꞌ xgab go' nde mblaꞌ goꞌ re jwanꞌ narax ndli goꞌ, nde naꞌlid go' xgab len' lazo' go': "naꞌ nde lo bin Abraham", tak na ni lo go', Dios toyal lilal Xa' re ke re' xin' Abraham.
Mbay na tagaꞌ yiꞌbya nda'bsa'lay sa choꞌy axta dib lox ya jwanꞌ nandaꞌda ngud wen, xchoꞌy nde yobiy lo bel.
Zyasa re men mnabdiꞌs lo Juan: —¿Cho kwan ndablo li náꞌ?
Juan mkab lo xaꞌ nchab: —Go' jwanꞌ ngeno chop ned lar, ndablo taꞌ go' thib neda lo xaꞌ nangenoda nek thiba; nde go' ngeno jwanꞌ ncha, naxal' gok go', taga' bli go'.
Noga ngwa pla xaꞌ jwanꞌ nthop tmi low par yez Rom lo Juan, sa koꞌle Juan xaꞌ, nde mnabdiꞌs xaꞌ lo Juan nchab xaꞌ: —Maestr, ¿kwan ndablo li náꞌ?
Juan nchab lo xaꞌ: —Naꞌnyabta goꞌ masra tmi jwanꞌ nandabloda kix xaꞌ.

Noga pla sondad mnabdiꞌs lo Juan nchab: —Mbay náꞌ, ¿kwan ndablo li náꞌ? Juan mkab lo xaꞌ: —Naꞌkibta goꞌ chanꞌ men, neka keꞌ goꞌ yalke yek men jwanꞌ ngen kwan ndli nde blo nale lazoꞌ goꞌ jwanꞌ nchax nka goꞌ.
Nde reta men nzimbed sin xaꞌ jwanꞌ telꞌ Dios nde mbli xaꞌ xgab nzo pa Juan nak Xaꞌ mtelꞌ Dios.

Per Juan nchab lo xaꞌ: —Na galꞌ diꞌs nin lo goꞌ, na ngole goꞌ kon nit, per tib xa' nde xis na, Xaꞌ ya ngeno mas yalne ke na, Xaꞌ koꞌle goꞌ kon Mbi Nayon nde kon bel. Nde nanzal'ta na xak na neka kore yalyid Xaꞌ.
Nzola pal ya Xaꞌ sa to Xaꞌ trig, tombi Xaꞌy nde kosaꞌ Xaꞌ trig tenꞌ nchosaꞌy, le' yix tolꞌ Xaꞌ lo bel jwanꞌ nanchuda.
Mod reꞌ mdej Juan nde masraꞌ ntobeꞌ Juan yek men, senꞌ mdej Juan diꞌs wen chanꞌ Dios lo men.
Mbay lo mtokox Juan Herodes xaꞌ nyebeꞌ lo xyon Galilea, tak ndobno xaꞌ Herodias, ngol Blib wes xaꞌ nde por reta temasra' jwanꞌ narax mbli xaꞌ,
mbliga' xa' tediba'y, mkeꞌ lizyiꞌb xa' Juan.
Jesus mbroꞌle
Senꞌ ngegoꞌle Juan re men, zyasa no Jesus mbroꞌle. Nde laj ngetodi'sno Jesus Dios, mxyalꞌ lo beꞌ,
nde mbla Mbi Nayon yek Jesus xaja nya thi paloma, zyasa mbyen thi diꞌs mbroꞌ lo beꞌ nchab: —Lu nak xinꞌ na jwanꞌ nkeꞌ toz lazoꞌn, nde nale toz nzo lazoꞌn ngwiꞌn la.
Lo bin jwan' nde Jesus
Sen' mdobte Jesus rsin' Jesus nzo Xa' mer galpsiꞌ linꞌ, nde reta men mbli xgab Jesus nak xinꞌ Jose. Nde Jose ngok xinꞌ Eli,
Eli ngok xinꞌ Matat, Matat ngok xinꞌ Levi, Levi ngok xinꞌ Melqui, Melqui ngok xinꞌ Jana, Jana ngok xinꞌ Jose,
Jose ngok xinꞌ Matatias, Matatias ngok xinꞌ Amos, Amos ngok xinꞌ Nahum, Nahum ngok xinꞌ Esli, Esli ngok xinꞌ Nagai,
Nagai ngok xinꞌ Maat, Maat ngok xinꞌ Matatias, Matatias ngok xinꞌ Semei, Semei ngok xinꞌ Jose, Jose ngok xinꞌ Juda,
Juda ngok xinꞌ Joana, Joana ngok xinꞌ Resa, Resa ngok xinꞌ Zorobabel, Zorobabel ngok xinꞌ Salatiel, Salatiel ngok xinꞌ Neri,
Neri ngok xinꞌ Melqui, Melqui ngok xinꞌ Adi, Adi ngok xinꞌ Cosam, Cosam ngok xinꞌ Elmodam, Elmodam ngok xinꞌ Er,
Er ngok xinꞌ Josue, Josue ngok xinꞌ Eliezer, Eliezer ngok xinꞌ Jorim, Jorim ngok xinꞌ Matat,
Matat ngok xinꞌ Levi, Levi ngok xinꞌ Simeon, Simeon ngok xinꞌ Juda, Juda ngok xinꞌ Jose, Jose ngok xinꞌ Jonan, Jonan ngok xinꞌ Eliaquim,
Eliaquim ngok xinꞌ Melea, Melea ngok xinꞌ Mainan, Mainan ngok xinꞌ Matata, Matata ngok xinꞌ Natan,
Natan ngok xinꞌ David, David ngok xinꞌ Isai, Isai ngok xinꞌ Obed, Obed ngok xinꞌ Booz, Booz ngok xinꞌ Salmon, Salmon ngok xinꞌ Naason,
Naason ngok xinꞌ Aminadab, Aminadab ngok xinꞌ Aram, Aram ngok xinꞌ Esrom, Esrom ngok xinꞌ Fares, Fares ngok xinꞌ Juda,
Juda ngok xinꞌ Jakob, Jakob ngok xinꞌ Isaac, Isaac ngok xinꞌ Abraham, Abraham ngok xinꞌ Tare, Tare ngok xinꞌ Nacor,
Nacor ngok xinꞌ Serug, Serug ngok xinꞌ Ragau, Ragau ngok xinꞌ Peleg, Peleg ngok xinꞌ Heber, Heber ngok xinꞌ Sala,
Sala ngok xinꞌ Cainan, Cainan ngok xinꞌ Arfaxad, Arfaxad ngok xinꞌ Sem, Sem ngok xinꞌ Noe, Noe ngok xinꞌ Lamec,
Lamec ngok xinꞌ Matusalen, Matusalen ngok xinꞌ Enoc, Enoc ngok xinꞌ Jared, Jared ngok xinꞌ Mahalaleel, Mahalaleel ngok xinꞌ Cainan,
Cainan ngok xinꞌ Enos, Enos ngok xinꞌ Set, Set ngok xinꞌ Adan, Adan ngok xinꞌ Dios.
